# TES auction table fixtures

Layout text excerpts from the complete official one-page PDFs saved under
`runs/2026-10-15/sources/followup/`. Retain the report heading, rate table,
and competitive-session amount table; omit later charts and intermediary
allocation tables. Only trailing whitespace was removed.

- October 14, 2026, auction 17: https://www.irc.gov.co/documents/d/guest/subasta-17-cop-octubre-14-de-2026?download=true
- September 23, 2026, auction 16: https://www.irc.gov.co/documents/d/guest/subasta-16-cop-septiembre-23-de-2026-1?download=true

The October 14 2035 row contains source anomalies in TI and TAIL. These are
retained in the fixture to prove they do not become cutoff/coupon values.
BID/COVER is copied as published; its denominator is not inferred.
